metadata.name: genesis.commit
metadata.description: Structure channel. Generator formulas ({genesis:true, cels:{...}}) enqueue here; the drain commits batches stamped generatedBy, diffs regenerations, and sweeps blooms whose generator is gone.

metadata.name: genesis.drain
metadata.description: (items) - commit generator requests via setCelBatch: ownership + overwrite, regeneration diff (structural identity; seeds at creation, user data plane preserved), layer segment stamping, orphan sweep, unsuppressed refire of stale consumers.
